versions.changelog: v1.1.0: Added AI-generated content labeling (persistent corner watermark + bilingual end notice card + MP4 metadata) for compliance with China AI content labeling rules; fixed ffprobe-less ffmpeg builds and Windows drive-letter colon issues in the subtitles filter.

Initial release of bilingual digital human spokesperson video generator:

- Generates a talking-head video with digital human delivering user-supplied script in English, then automatically in Arabic.
- Auto-translates English scripts to Arabic or uses supplied Arabic text.
- Creates realistic presenter avatar and lip-syncs both English and Arabic voiceovers using SadTalker (local), D-ID/HeyGen (cloud), or image-to-video fallback.
- Outputs a single video with both language segments, bilingual subtitles, and segment title cards.
- Supports simple inputs and customizable avatar, voice, and layout for cross-border e-commerce, education, and promo scenarios.
